newsitem.title: USA: Assistant Interior Secretary Frampton resigns.
newsitem.headline: Assistant Interior Secretary Frampton resigns.

text.p: Assistant Interior Secretary George Frampton has resigned effective Feb. 14, the Interior Department said Monday.

Frampton, who came to the department after serving as president of the Wilderness Society, oversaw a number of controversial programmes including efforts to protect endangered species and to restore the Florida Everglades.

"George Frampton has done a masterful job with an extraordinarily complex set of issues from the Everglades restoration to acquiring fragile lands in Alaska, from conservation planning in coastal California counties to the addition of Boston Harbour to our national park system," Interior Secretary Bruce Babbitt said in a statement.
Frampton did not have immediate plans but intended to take some time off, a department spokeswoman said.
